notes: Sepolia test deployment (chain ID 11155111). The five accepted contracts are listed in constructor dependency order; $contract references resolve to earlier deployments. All privileged owner arguments, the initial furniture royalty receiver and the MockOG initial supply recipient use $owner. MockOG has 18 decimals, an initial supply of one trillion tokens and unrestricted public minting; this manifest is for testnet use only. OGClubFurniture is the ERC-1155 prize contract, with a 5% initial royalty bounded at 10%. OGClubFarmVault holds MockOG unstake fees and pays delayed Merkle seasons without an owner withdrawal function. OGClubStaking references MockOG and that immutable vault, charges a rounded-up 1% unstake fee, and uses the accepted deployment script's default pointsPerTokenDay of 1000000000000000000: one point per whole staked token per day. OGClubRaffle references staking and furniture with raffleNotice=0. No OGClubBox is deployed. These nonpayable constructors do not authorize the raffle to mint furniture or spend points. After deployment and before opening raffles, $owner must call OGClubFurniture.grantMinter with the confirmed OGClubRaffle address as the furniture's FIRST grant, and OGClubStaking.grantSpender with that address as staking's FIRST grant. Verify minters(raffle) and spenders(raffle) are true. Each first grant is immediate; subsequent grants require activation from proposal+7 days through proposal+14 days inclusive, otherwise they lapse. Revocation is immediate. These owner operations are described for handoff only; this manifest contains no initialization calls and does not perform or guarantee the grants. Furniture metadata is configured separately by its owner. Raffle pools and prize lists are immutable after creation. Draws authenticate a future block header; retargeting after target+256 blocks allows selection bias if all draws are withheld until expiry. Vault seasons reserve at most 50% of the unreserved balance, open after 3 days, close 90 days after opening, and require at least 7 days between proposals. Mainnet requires a separate deployment using the existing OG token, a fresh deployer, OWNER a Safe and RAFFLE_NOTICE=604800. No deployment or broadcast was performed.
